description: Whitespace family (crates/twig-fuzz/src/generators/whitespace.rs): Hand-written probes written next to the generator, recorded with the oracle (all match, so every vector must keep replaying identically; recorded with "isolation": "process"). Lexer edges: nested interpolations, empty prints, tags and comments with trims, unclosed comments, strings, brackets, verbatim blocks and tags at the end of the template, `{% line %}` spellings (leading zeros, newlines, a number past PHP_INT_MAX), number literals (`1_000`, `1.e3`, `0x10`), operators next to delimiters, inline `#` and `##` comments, `\v`/`\f`/NUL/NEL/NBSP inside tags, BOMs, raw CR and CRLF line endings.
